# Houston Estate Planning and Probate Attorney

## Clear Guidance for Important Family Decisions

Example Law Firm helps Houston families prepare estate plans and navigate probate matters. Clients work directly with an attorney who explains each stage in plain language and documents the decisions that matter to the family.

The firm assists with wills, trusts, powers of attorney, advance healthcare directives, probate administration, and related estate matters. Consultations for estate planning and probate are paid appointments.

### Call 555-0100 to Discuss a Consultation

## About Attorney Jordan Example

Jordan Example has practiced in the Houston area since beginning a legal career in civil litigation. The practice later expanded to focus on estate planning and probate matters for individuals and families.

Jordan works with clients to document their wishes, identify the people responsible for carrying them out, and prepare the appropriate estate-planning instruments.

## Estate Planning Services

- Wills
- Trusts
- Powers of attorney
- Advance healthcare directives

## Probate Services

The firm guides families through estate administration and the documents required for a probate matter. The scope depends on the estate and the court requirements that apply to the matter.

## What Clients Can Expect

Clients receive direct explanations of the documents being prepared and the decisions those documents record. Remote meetings are available when a court appearance is not required.
